objectives.text: Declare and use a generic class and a generic method with a type parameter
Explain how a type argument such as List<String> turns a run-time ClassCastException into a compile-time error
Choose between List<T>, List<? extends T> and List<? super T> for a method parameter that only reads from or only writes to a list
